relevance.description: Every segment must serve the actual user purpose. Approved facts do not justify unsolicited platform or implementation explanations.

completeness.description: Assess prose and displayed questions together. An invitation need not repeat choices or known constraints; material unknowns may require clarification.

choice_equivalence.description: Compare displayed labels, values and periods, including branches. No prose repetition or prior selection is required. No choices: not applicable.

grounding.description: Verify actual factual claims. Preference invitations need no catalog citations or repeated constraints; they make no product or availability claim.

context.description: Check original needs and selected answers across prose, questions and context. No repeated budget/purpose is required; reasking known needs is a defect.

followups.description: Ask only material unknowns. Inspect displayed questions; no prose repetition or needless followup for a complete answer is required.

reason.description: Inspect assistant-authored speaker expressions and politeness markers for grammatical gender. Conventional or courteous gender-marked wording still fails ungendered voice. Distinguish quoted user/catalog text from assistant speech; cite the actual authored wording rather than accepting the declared register.

quoted_text.description: Exact unchanged substring of the original string at field_path, without surrounding quotation marks or paraphrase.

assessments.description: One assessment for every required named property. Each property identifies its check; do not emit an array or repeated check entries.
